what: From blaze-builds-blaze run self2 (/Volumes/Projects/.coord-1030/b2-build/self2-self.log:385): crates_by_prefix (key.rs ~1101) panicked on two Crates of object@0.39.1's build-script-build with one key. Lane cargo fixed the cause in blaze-lower (lib.rs lower_into: units whose crate inputs are all equal, as cargo keeps two units apart for a profile's opt-level/debuginfo only, now share one Crate; test units_apart_only_in_what_the_front_end_does_not_read_are_one_crate). Two asks for key.rs: (1) no-fallback: the duplicate is a stop of the daemon by panic; make it a typed error naming both crates and their packages, returned to the build (crates_by_prefix -> Result, or the caller checks). (2) crate_key (key.rs:92) does not hash the crate's env, so two crates that differ only in env (OUT_DIR from two runs of one build script, env! values, CARGO_PKG_*) get one key and their items are taken for each other's; blaze-lower keeps them two crates. Hash krate.env(db) (sorted) into crate_key, or say why env cannot change what an item names.
